title: useDocumentTitle Hook
description:
Implement a `useDocumentTitle` hook that sets `document.title` to the given string after each render where `title` changes.

**Example:**
```tsx
useDocumentTitle(`${user.name} — Code Forge`);
```
ai_context: This is intentionally simple — the challenge teaches that useEffect with a dependency array is the correct pattern for synchronising a React value with an external system (the document title), not for data fetching.
